overall_goal: Stir the curry and bring it to a boil

goals.description: Stir the contents of the pot and adjust the heat
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly stirs the pot to prevent sticking and then adjusts the heat level before setting the spoon aside.

goals.description: Stir the vegetables, check the heat level, and cover the pot to boil
goals.rationale: The person stirs the pot, ensures the vegetables are submerged, checks and adjusts the heat, and finally covers the pot to let it boil.
